mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tighter monetary policy, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in real GDP indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines > 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and related sectors' earnings decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with a rise in consumer price index signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4% and CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP combined with a decrease in the federal funds rate signals a stimulative economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5%
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5%.
